description: Sets (creates or updates) a custom field on an inventory item referenced by its name instead of its id, so you can act on a request like "set the roast level for regular beans to Dark" in one step. Provide the item name (matched within the user's company), the field name (an existing field with that name is reused, otherwise created), and the value. showInTable is a per-field, company-wide setting: true shows the field as a column for every item. If the name matches no item or more than one, the result explains what happened and lists candidates so you can confirm with the user.
name: set_inventory_item_custom_field_by_name
